data.author: Aladhi
data.description:
Mean Reversion Channel (MRC). A Keltner-style channel around a SuperSmoother mean: the inner channel acts as dynamic support/resistance, the outer channel and its gradient zone mark overbought/oversold areas.

Ported from the TradingView script by fareidzulkifli (Mozilla Public License 2.0). The mean can use SuperSmoother, Ehlers EMA, Gaussian, Butterworth, BandStop, SMA, EMA or RMA filters. The multi timeframe labels of the original are not included.
